Still open, per TechCrunch: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI.
Confirmed, per Yahoo! Finance Canada: ServiceNow and OpenAI accelerate enterprise AI, from models and operations to cybersecurity and agentic development.
Confirmed, per Community Impact: Pflugerville adopts new policy for AI, surveillance technology and data privacy.
Confirmed, per Decrypt: AI Security Startup Upwind Raises $400M at $3.8B Valuation.
